properties.nhcTitle: East of the Leeward Islands (Remnants of Dolly)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorm continue in association with the remnants  of Tropical Storm Dolly, located about 150 miles east of the Leeward  Islands. However, there are no signs that the system is developing a  closed circulation. Redevelopment of this system is unlikely while  it moves westward to west-northwestward near 25 mph. The wave could  bring locally heavy rains and gusty winds to portions of the Leeward  Islands, the Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico over the next several  days. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...10 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Northeastern and North-Central Gulf of America (AL97)
properties.discussion:
A weak low pressure area located around 125 miles south of  Pensacola, Florida is producing showers and thunderstorms. Some  additional slow development of this system is possible during the  next few days as it drifts westward across the northern Gulf. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

An area of disturbed weather, associated with a tropical wave, is  located well to the south of southwestern Mexico. This system is  expected to move west-northwestward to northwestward at 10 to 15  mph. Environmental conditions appear favorable for gradual  development of this system, and a tropical depression is likely to  form during the early to middle part of next week. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...50 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south or southwest of the  Hawaiian Islands in the next few days. Some gradual development is  possible thereafter and a tropical depression could form during the  middle to latter part of next week. The system should move slowly  west-northwestward, and stay well southwest of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...40 percent.
